title: Schedule A to the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts Credit Agreement: Limits, Terms and Entry Conditions
content:
Schedule A sets, for each programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, the limit the account opens with, the ceiling it may be carried to, the payment terms it buys on, the day its statement closes, the credit review it is opened and kept under, whether a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is required, the acres the member must enrol, and whether product is paid for as it leaves the plant.

## 1. Programme schedule

| Programme | Opening limit (USD) | Ceiling (USD) | Terms (calendar days) | Statement closes | Credit review at entry | Review interval (months) | Security interest required | Acres to enrol | Paid for on delivery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | day 25 | no | 0 | no | 0 | yes |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 25000 | 75000 | 30 | day 25 | yes | 24 | no | 0 | no |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 90000 | 250000 | 180 | day 25 | yes | 12 | no | 250 | no |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | day 25 | no | 0 | no | 0 | no |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 250000 | 750000 | 300 | day 25 | yes | 12 | yes | 500 | no |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 400000 | 1200000 | 330 | day 25 | yes | 12 | yes | 1000 | no |

## 2. Reading of the columns

2.1 The opening limit is the limit an approved account of that programme opens with; the ceiling is the highest limit the programme will carry without board approval.

2.2 The terms are the payment terms counted in calendar days from the invoice date. A programme carrying terms of 0 days is a programme on which product is paid for at the time it leaves the plant.

2.3 The statement of every programme in Crop Input Purchasing Accounts closes on day 25 of the month.

2.4 A review interval of 0 months belongs to a programme that is not opened under a credit review at all; on the other programmes the interval is how often an open account is reviewed again, at 24 months on the Standard 30-Day Charge Account and at 12 months on the Seasonal Terms, Full Acre and Precision Partner programmes.

2.5 Acres to enrol are the acres a member must have enrolled to hold the programme: none below the Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account, 250 on it, 500 on the Full Acre Input Financing Account and 1000 on the Precision Partner Input Program Account.

## 3. Points of judgement

**A member asks which programmes are opened without a credit review.** The Cash Purchase Account and the Early Pay Prepay Program Account, which carry no limit and no terms; every other programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts is opened under a review.

**A member on the Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account asks how far their limit can be carried.** The programme opens at 90000 USD and its ceiling is 250000 USD.

**A member asks which programmes call for a perfected security interest on the growing crop.** The Full Acre Input Financing Account and the Precision Partner Input Program Account.
